thought.text: Service restarted with the preset minus the diarize step. Now let me trigger a fresh file and monitor for a transcript.

reasoning_content:
The service has started with the new config (no diarize step). The .local/models/.initialized marker — wait, I deleted .local/data/asr (DB), but the /models volume is still at .local/models, and since .initialized exists, the model download won't be re-executed. Good.

Next, re-trigger the file. Note: the old job (5ecce521) may get retried with the old preset (saved in the DB) — but since I cleared .local/data/asr, the new DB should pick up the config's presets. Let's trigger the file and monitor it.

action.command: cd /workspace/deployments/example-opencode && cp watch/verify.wav watch/final.wav && chown 1000:1000 watch/final.wav && for i in $(seq 1 12); do sleep 30; st=$(docker compose --env-file .env-example --env-file .env -f compose.yml -f compose.cpu.yml ps --format '{{.Name}}: {{.Status}}' 2>&1 | grep asr); echo "=== iter $i: $st"; docker compose --env-file .env-example --env-file .env -f compose.yml -f compose.cpu.yml logs --since 2m asr-service 2>&1 | tr '\r' '\n' | grep -viE "DEBUG|httpcore|GPUWatchdog|monitor|it/s|MB/s|Downloading" | tail -5; echo "--- watch:"; ls watch/ | grep -viE "keep|jfk16k|test.wav|verify.wav"; if ls watch/ 2>/dev/null | grep -qiE "\.txt$|Transkript|\.vtt$|\.srt$"; then echo "TRANSCRIPT FOUND!"; break; fi; done
